text:
marta: Drafting release notes for 2.9.1 (serving runtime + smart routing fixes). Need ops/docs/legal quick sign-off today so I can pin and kick the deploybot tomorrow. Target pin by 2024-09-01 17:00 PT. Deploy window 2024-09-02 00:00-04:00 UTC. Who can run final smoke? Any regional embargo/locale callouts? :clock1:
jen: Quick ask — add an explicit rollback criteria section. e.g., rollback if error rate > 2% sustained for 5m OR token latency p95 > 150ms for 10m. Also call out the SDK change for the new `truncate` param.
sam: Also please add a short blurb for Dedicated customers about scheduled quiesce and how we’ll pin model variants during the rollout. EU teams: do we need an embargo note for local legal?
lucas: Oncall for that window — I can run the final smoke 00:00-02:00 UTC. I’ll follow the smoke checklist: health checks, 3 sample prompts / embeddings, KV cache warmup, and alert sanity. I’ll post results here. Rollback tag will be `revert/2.9.1` if needed.
deploy-bot: INFO: Canary plan uploaded: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 15m ramps between stages. Auto-rollback if canary error rate delta > 1.5% vs baseline. Command preview: `/deploy start v2.9.1 --canary=5 --ramp=15m --annotations="internal-announce:pending"`
marta: Thanks — added rollback criteria and Dedicated blurb to the draft. Also added a one-paragraph security note for legal to quickly eyeball. Draft link: https://docs.internal/release-notes/2.9.1-draft (please comment inline). Added staging smoke checklist at the bottom.
jen: LGTMs on content. Small wording nit: change "model pinning" to "version pin (pinned model artifact)" so customers aren't confused. Also add an example curl snippet for the SDK change.
sam: I’ll take care of the internal-announce cadence. Plan: post to `internal-announce` 30m after canary reaches 25% (so oncall has time to escalate). I’ll include ops runbook snippet and who to ping.
lucas: I’ll run smoke and post logs here. Reminder for the smoke run: include EU region tests specifically for routing fallback to EU variants. If smoke fails, I’ll invoke `revert/2.9.1` and notify ops-rotation.
deploy-bot: SCHEDULED: Deploy scheduled to start 2024-09-02T00:00:00Z. Canary sequence and rollback thresholds saved to release artifact `manifest-2.9.1.json`.
marta: One more to add — please confirm timezones in the pinned announce (we usually show UTC + PT). I’ll pin the draft once everyone gives a 👍.
jen: 👍 on content from docs side — added curl snippet and small language tweak.
sam: 👍 from comms. I’ll draft the internal blurb and share a quick preview here before posting.
lucas: Smoke checklist runbook approved. I’ll be ready for the 00:00 start and will cut logs into this thread. If anything odd, I’ll escalate to ops-sre and trigger the rollback.
marta: Great — pinning the draft at 2024-09-01T17:00 PT unless an objection before then. I’ll also add a short FAQ line about Dedicated failover and model variant mapping.
jen: No objections.
sam: No objections. I’ll prepare the announce template and localize quick lines for EU/APAC.
lucas: Copy.
marta: Thanks team — I’ll post the pinned link and set the deploybot annotation to `internal-announce:pending` so comms trigger happens automatically when canary hits 25%. :white_check_mark:
